data.long_meaning: The name Sachita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sachit', which means 'living consciousness'. It is a name that signifies good luck, fortune, and prosperity. In Hinduism, it is believed that the goddess Sachidevi, who is an embodiment of fortune and prosperity, bestows her blessings upon those named after her. The name Sachita carries the meaning “Lucky, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sachita usually hope their child will grow to embody lucky, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
